_comment: Pins 637343f (Report upstream token usage instead of silently billing zero). Anthropic reports input tokens once on message_start and output tokens on message_delta, whose usage carries no input_tokens. The Responses encoder folded each usage delta by assignment, so the message_delta report (input 0) overwrote the message_start one and response.completed told the client input_tokens: 0. Usage deltas must merge field-wise.

content.text: Reply with the single word: ok
